verdict.rationale: Starting audio or video calls from a channel or DM is a fair axis for a team chat product like Zulip, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about calls, video, audio or huddles; it covers only topics, channels, search, bots, integrations, export and self-hosting.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app
